      <title>The Goat's Eyes: How a Minister's Trick Saved Krishna Deva Raya and Forged an Empire</title>
      <description>In this episode, the dying king Busbalrao orders his minister Salvatimya to blind his brother Krishna Deva Raya and place his eight-year-old son on the throne. Salvatimya saves Krishna by substituting a goat's eyes, and the young prince rises to become one of India's greatest kings — launching a devastating eastern campaign that captures Udayagiri after an eighteen-month siege, crushes the Gajapati army at a river crossing, and takes Kondapalli, where the Orissan prince kills himself rather than duel a commoner. Based on A Forgotten Empire (Vijayanagara) by Robert Sewell (1900).</description>
